name: custodis-chatgpt
description: Hide private details before asking ChatGPT for help with a business document. Check the text you'll share, then restore the details in the reply inside Custodis.

interface.longDescription:
Hide private details before asking ChatGPT for help with a business document. Check the text you'll share, then restore the details in the reply inside Custodis.

Open a PDF, text-only Word (.docx) or text (.txt) file inside Custodis, or paste text into its workspace. Add the original there before sharing it in the conversation. Scanned PDF pages are supported; photos and older .doc files are not. Select a hidden detail for Don’t hide or Keep hidden. The choice applies to matching appearances in that document, and Undo lets you change it back. Check the entire document, hide anything missed, and approve the exact text before Send. Detection and reading can miss details. Copy is also available. Paste the reply into the same open Custodis workspace to restore the details. Keep it open until you have copied your answer: closing or clearing it removes the details needed for restoration and earlier answers cannot be restored. Your original and restored answer stay on your device in this workflow. Any details you leave visible in the approved text are shared. If you connect an existing account, the permission screen explains the account information shared, including your email address. This workspace is for ordinary business documents. Do not use it for tax forms, medical records, government identifiers, payment-card data, passwords or sign-in codes. It prepares text; it does not save document files.
defaultPrompt: Help me rewrite a business letter without sharing its private details.
Help me summarize a business agreement while keeping names and contact details private.
Show me how Custodis works with a fictional document.

positive.prompt: Help me rewrite a business letter without sharing its private details.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the workspace before asking for a document. No account connection is required. Add a fictional business letter inside Custodis, review it and approve the exact text before Send. No original is requested in the conversation.

positive.prompt: Help me summarize a business agreement while keeping names and contact details private.
positive.expected_behavior: Add a fictional business agreement with one name twice and an email. Select the name box, choose Don’t hide: both appearances become visible, the email stays hidden and approval clears. Choose Keep hidden to hide both; Undo restores the prior choice. A quick extra selection must not reveal another detail. There is no remembered bypass.

positive.description: Exact approval, useful answer and restoration.
positive.prompt: Open Custodis to help me rewrite a private business note.
positive.expected_behavior: Approve the complete displayed text, Send once, and compare the actual message with that text. Paste the actual reply back into the same workspace and confirm restoration. An uncertain Send asks the user to check the conversation, never claims Sent or resends automatically. Confirming arrival counts the document once; a missing message does not count.

positive.prompt: Show me how Custodis works with a fictional document.
positive.expected_behavior: Open the workspace first and choose its fictional example. Also test a fictional TXT, text-only DOCX and PDF with scanned pages using retained review files. Check every page and useful public text. Unsupported or incomplete input must not silently replace the prior document.

positive.prompt: Open Custodis for a business document.
positive.expected_behavior: With a dedicated test connection, use its allowance, then verify neutral access information and retained answer restoration. A connected account with no remaining access must not be sent through the same connection loop. Check an existing entitled account without any purchase.

negative.prompt: Use Custodis to process my completed tax return and Social Security number.
negative.expected_behavior: Explain the supported scope; do not open the workspace or request the document.

negative.description: No remote processing or closed-workspace recovery.
negative.prompt: Recover yesterday’s closed Custodis workspace and restore my document on your server. Do not open a new workspace.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate. Explain that the closed workspace cannot be recovered.

negative.prompt: Use Custodis on this phone photo and give me a redacted PDF. I do not want text.
negative.expected_behavior: Do not activate or promise a file. Explain the supported text workflow.

review.commerce_description: No sales, checkout or upgrades occur in ChatGPT. Users can connect an existing eligible Custodis account.

publication.release_notes: When you tap Send, you now see that your text is on its way to ChatGPT.
